RESPECT THE CREATOR

Private beta use conditions

ClipNest helps you check the available qualities of a video and prepare a temporary download. Participation is currently by private invitation.

Use only with the required authorization

Submit only material you are authorized to download, and comply with the source service’s terms and the law that applies to you. Rights-holder permission and the source platform’s permission are separate considerations. Read YouTube’s Terms of Service before using this service. ClipNest is independent of YouTube and does not grant rights to any content.

Account and acceptable use

Keep your password and file links private. Do not use the service to bypass access controls, DRM, age or geographic restrictions, or private-content permissions. Do not automate abuse, evade limits, share accounts to bypass allowances, or submit malicious links. The operator can pause new downloads or suspend an account to investigate abuse.

Availability and limits

Formats depend on the original upload. The service does not increase the source quality. Downloads can fail when the source changes or restricts access. Speed depends on source limits, processing, server capacity and your connection. File and daily allowances are shown by the connected service. Prepared files expire; save them promptly. This beta does not promise continuous availability or a minimum speed.

Privacy and help

See the privacy notice for retention, export and deletion. Contact your beta inviter for support or to report content or account abuse. The operator’s public identity, public contact, eligible markets and final contractual terms must be confirmed before a public release.

Beta scope

This release has no paid plan, payment collection or billing. The beta is available only to invited adults who can accept these use conditions. The operator can end the beta; export your account information and save files you need before requesting closure.
